title: Homotopically projective right DG modules
statement: Use the associative unital differential graded integer algebras and right DG modules of [def-sfb-dg-derived-category], and homogeneous right-linear cochains of [def-sfb-dg-bimodule-models]. A right DG $A$-module $P$ is homotopically projective if for every right DG $A$-module $N$ with acyclic underlying complex, every integer $r$ and every closed degree-$r$ right $A$-linear cochain $f:P\to N$, there exists a degree-$(r-1)$ right $A$-linear cochain $g$ with $\delta(g)=f$. Here $\delta(f)=d_Nf-(-1)^rfd_P$, and homogeneous right linearity is $f(xa)=f(x)a$ without a sign. Thus the condition is exactly acyclicity of the right-linear Hom complex. No boundedness or finiteness condition is imposed.
